text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pampasan Pekerja

(Skim Pampasan Pekerja Asing) (Insurans) (Pindaan) (No. 2) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 Oktober 2011.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Pampasan Pekerja (Skim Pampasan Pekerja Asing) (Insurans) 2005

[P.U. (A) 45/2005] dipinda dalam Jadual dengan memasukkan selepas butiran "Malaysia

National Insurance Berhad" butiran "MSIG Insurance (Malaysia) Berhad".

Dibuat 20 September 2011

[KSM/PUU/T/01/05/16 Jld. 3; PN(PU2)296/V]

 DATUK DR. S. SUBRAMANIAM A/L K.V. SATHASIVAM

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

WORKMEN'S COMPENSATION ACT 1952

WORKMEN'S COMPENSATION (FOREIGN WORKERS' COMPENSATION SCHEME)

(INSURANCE) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 26(2) of the Workmen's

Compensation Act 1952 [Act 273], the Minister makes the following order:
